description: This file contains the implementation of a SCSS syntax parser and stringifier for PostCSS, including classes for parsing SCSS code and converting it back to string form, as well as functions for parsing SCSS code into an AST.

classes.name: NestedDeclaration
classes.description: A class extending Container, representing nested CSS declarations in SCSS.

classes.name: ScssParser
classes.description: A class extending parser, responsible for parsing SCSS syntax into an AST.

classes.name: ScssStringifier
classes.description: A class extending Stringifier, responsible for converting AST nodes back into SCSS code.

methods.name: scssParse
methods.description: Function that initializes the parser with input and parses SCSS code into an AST.

methods.name: scssStringify
methods.description: Function that stringifies an AST into SCSS code.
